title: Do Not Overstretch Funding
primary_theme: Hands-on early-stage B2B investing anchored in entrepreneurial experience
founder_lessons: Choose investors who have lived the founder pain and can offer hands-on help at pivotal moments.
Optimize the venture platform for the stage you serve rather than growing AUM for its own sake.
Stay anchored in markets where the firm has unfair advantage and enough foundational company inventory.
Do not forget that regulation and capital flows shape whether entrepreneurs can do their best work.
notable_quotes: The greatest gift that we have as a country is entrepreneurship.
capital is somewhat of a commodity.
I was lucky to get involved with the American Indian Foundation.
